title: 第340章 后遗症
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“咳咳，赵子寒道友莫要生气，我们就是对这丹药好奇而已，并非不信任道友。”

名叫裴清瑞的老者，看到赵子寒和其身边的矮瘦老者有些不满，干笑了一下后，就对其他三人说道：

“都吃了吧，虽然只能分四层凝元草，但也总比一点没有强！更何况如今距离半年之期已不远了，离开这里，未必还能找到其他未被探寻过的凝元宝地。”

“好。”

另外三名裴家筑基强者闻言，纷纷把“爆元丹”往嘴里一塞，就吃了进去。

紧接着，四人的脸颊就迅速变得红彤彤的一片。

“赵原哥，我们也吃。”

赵子寒见状眼底微微一亮，马上又倒出两粒爆元丹，将其中一粒递给身旁的矮瘦老者。

“好。”

赵原接过药丸，看也不看就一口吞了下去。

这让原本还有些担心的裴家四人，立刻把心放到了肚子里。

赵子寒也将手中药丸吃下，然后跟裴家几人一样，脸颊迅速变得通红一片。

随即沉声道：“诸位，此药维持不了多少时间，大家听我命令，不要有任何保留，准备全力一击！能否破开此阵，就在这一次了。”

“好。”

裴清瑞正色一点头。

紧接着，一群人就纷纷一展身形，在结界东边的六座巨石之上一字排开，做好准备进攻的架势。

“大家准备，老夫数到三，就一起出手！”赵子寒朝裴家四人看了一眼，随即开始数了起来。

“一！”

“二！”

“三！”

“轰——”

随着赵子寒话音一落，顿时六股颜色不一的巨型光柱，同时从六人双掌之中射出。

狠狠地击打在了结界之上。

巨大的响声震得天地嗡嗡作响，同时一股狂暴的余波，排山倒海般朝四周席卷而来。

至于那个宛如锅盖一样的五彩结界，则被六人联手一击，当场光芒一暗，直接原地爆炸。

“好恐怖的爆元丹！”韩林见到此景，忍不住地瞳孔一缩，心中震撼之情无以复加。

别人暂且不论，就说裴家那三名筑基初期修为之人，刚才那一击的威力，就不亚于一名筑基后期强者全力一击。

若是没有服用爆元丹，韩林绝不相信，哪个筑基初期修士，能打出这么强大的伤害。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Ahem, fellow Taoist Zhao Zihan, don't be angry. We are just curious about this elixir. It's not that we don't trust fellow Taoist."

The old man named Pei Qingrui was a little dissatisfied when he saw Zhao Zihan and the short and thin old man beside him. After laughing dryly, he said to the other three people:

"Eat them all. Although it can only be divided into four layers of Condensing Yuan Grass, it is still better than nothing! What's more, the half-year period is not far away now. If you leave here, you may not be able to find other unexplored Condensing Yuan Treasure lands."

"Okay."

After hearing this, the other three Pei family foundation-building experts stuffed the "Explosive Yuan Dan" into their mouths and ate it.

Immediately afterwards, the cheeks of the four people quickly turned red.

"Brother Zhao Yuan, let's eat too."

Zhao Zihan's eyes lit up slightly when he saw this, and he immediately poured out two more Explosive Yuan Pills and handed one of them to the short and thin old man beside him.

"Okay."

Zhao Yuan took the pill and swallowed it in one gulp without looking at it.

This made the four members of the Pei family, who were a little worried at first, immediately put their hearts in their stomachs.

Zhao Zihan also took the pills in his hand, and like the others in the Pei family, his cheeks quickly turned red.

Then he said in a deep voice: "Everyone, this medicine won't last long. Listen to my order, don't hold anything back, prepare to strike with all your strength! Whether you can break through this formation, this is the time."

"Okay."

Pei Qingrui nodded seriously.

Immediately afterwards, a group of people showed up and lined up on the six boulders to the east of the barrier, getting ready to attack.

"Everyone, get ready. When I count to three, we will take action together!" Zhao Zihan glanced at the four members of the Pei family and then started counting.

"One!"

"Two!"

"Three!"

"Boom——"

As soon as Zhao Zihan finished speaking, six huge beams of light of different colors shot out from the palms of the six people at the same time.

It hit the barrier hard.

The huge sound shook the world and the earth, and at the same time, a violent aftermath swept towards the surroundings like an overwhelming force.

As for the colorful barrier that looked like a pot lid, six people jointly attacked it. The light dimmed on the spot and exploded on the spot.

"What a terrifying Exploding Yuan Dan!" Han Lin couldn't help but shrink his pupils when he saw this scene, and the shock in his heart could not be greater.

Ignoring others for the time being, let's just say that the power of the blow just struck by the three people from the Pei family who were in the early stage of foundation building was no less powerful than a full blow from a strong person in the late stage of foundation building.

If he hadn't taken the Exploding Yuan Pill, Han Lin would never believe that any early-stage foundation-building monk could deal such powerful damage.
